4,756 likes, 30 comments - mahathalli on October 5, 2026: "You know when someone gets way too defensive about their favourite thing? 😂

I casually pointed out a few things about our Bosch Dishwasher… and let’s just say, he had a LOT to say. 😌

But after looking at what it actually does, I kind of get it:

✨ Up to 80 everyday Indian utensils — and smaller bowls and spoons can take the count up to 100.
✨ Intensive Kadhai Programme — made for tough Indian cooking stains, so no pre-scrubbing needed.
✨ Steam Treatment + 70°C Hot Water Wash — helps tackle stubborn oil and grease while being suitable for delicate crockery.
✨ 2 Powerful Spray Arms — designed for effective pressure and coverage, so water reaches every corner.
✨ 10-Year Anti-Rust Warranty — for long-term protection of the dishwasher interior.
✨ 100% Money-Back Guarantee — if you’re not satisfied with the cleaning, Bosch has you covered.

Add a Finish tablet, switch on the Intensive Kadhai Programme and let Bosch handle the rest😌

Okay fine… maybe I did take the rage bait a little too far. 😂

#BoschDishwasher #BoschHomeAppliances #FinishTablet #FinishDishwasherTablets #AD".

2,196 likes, 6 comments - mahathalli on October 3, 2026: "Ready for a science class? 🧪 

-We Upgrade Everything. Why Not Our Water? 💧 

Since 1995, we’ve upgraded almost everything around us - furniture, smartphones, TVs, refrigerators, ACs, washing machines and more. 

But the water our entire family drinks, from children to grandparents?
Still the same RO water.

In 2026, clean water is just the beginning.

We researched, rethought and upgraded from a conventional RO purifier to the Tyent UCE-13 PLUS Water Ionizer.🫰🏼
It delivers clean, filtered, ionized hydrogen-rich alkaline water, while retaining naturally occurring alkaline minerals, along with dissolved selective anti-oxidant molecular hydrogen. 

Because hydration shouldn’t just be clean. It should be clean, pure, healthy & and should support complete family health!!! ‼️

Adhi Sangathi… 😎".

119K likes, 76 comments - isushanthreddy on September 7, 2026: "Happy Birthday to the one who keeps life life-ing always exciting and happening! ❤️

You’re doing an amazing job managing life and, most importantly, a mother. Watching you be a mom has honestly been one of my favourite things. 

Thank you for taking care of us, standing strong, and always pushing me to stay grounded, learn and try new things.

And of course… it’s your birthday, but you still pushed me for a morning safari because you’ve already done it before and I shouldn’t miss it! 😂

That’s just you. ❤️

Happy Birthday, Janu! 🥂".
